name: Pangasinan Puzzle Party 2025
information:
This is the 2nd installment of Pangasinan Puzzle Party 2025!

Quick Details:
Registration Period: July 25 - September 11
Registration Fee:
Newcomers: Php 250.00 (good for 2 events)
Returnes: Php 400.00 (good for 4 events). 
Please see [payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PangasinanPuzzleParty2025#58706-payment-details) for more info.
